grades.composition: "Modified Polyester alloy and oyster shell powder" (R-NANOVIA-ISTROFLEX-SDS, p. 1); "a heavy polymer, based on biodegradable monomers and cosmetic grade oyster shells" (R-NANOVIA-ISTROFLEX, as printed). A compostable polyester alloy with a glass transition of -32 °C (its safety data sheet) and a Vicat of 91 °C, PBAT's kind by those figures; Nanovia names no polymer, and it stays in the maker-undisclosed elastomer home as the rubber it is, Shore 44D / 93A (the owner's rulings, 2026-10-20, R232, D176). Its density, 1.55 g/cm³ on the page and 1.34 on the safety data sheet, is above an unfilled elastomer's: the oyster-shell load is a declared dense filler (D57, R095).

Maker claims or named finishing options only; no demonstrated application validation, suitability or screening pass. Other products of the material remain individually bounded. No radiation-shielding qualification is established. Flex VX intended-use claims are separately recorded and do not establish medical or safety certification.
Canonical identity recorded: Thermoplastic elastomer, elastomer not disclosed by the maker (Flexible Elastomers, base polymer TPE). Aliases and disputed entries are family entries of their own.
H2C status recorded: Theoretical. Generic inclusion is not automatic grade or route approval. Cited: H2C-WIKI, H2C-MANUAL.
